verification.title: Verification
verification.identityBody: Verified through Stripe Identity. They hold your documents — Scrlpets only ever stores whether the check passed.

verification.buyerBody: Confirm you understand what bringing an animal home involves.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.subtitle: Earned by doing the things that make the marketplace work.
rewards.earnHelp: Points come from publishing your first listing, completing a handover, and reviewing someone you dealt with. They cannot be bought and do not convert to cash.
rewards.badgesNotice: These count real activity. They are not an endorsement by Scrlpets.
rewards.notEnoughPoints: You don't have enough points yet.
rewards.pendingLegalReview: Not available yet — pending legal review.

subscriptions.title: Plans
subscriptions.subtitle: A plan lowers the fee on your own completed sales. It buys nothing else.
subscriptions.sellerPaysNotice: The seller pays the fee on every plan. Buyers pay the same price no matter which plan a seller is on.
subscriptions.notEnabled: Plans aren't switched on yet. Nothing here can be purchased.

referrals.title: Invite people
referrals.linkBody: Anyone who joins with this link is recorded as invited by you.

referrals.empty: No one has used your link yet.
referrals.howBody: Points arrive when someone you invited actually does something — publishes a listing, or completes a handover you both confirmed. Sending the link earns nothing on its own.
referrals.howNotice: You're paid once per person, and only for people who were new to Scrlpets.
